evals.prompt: Synthesize a market brief from market-notes.md (in your working directory): the segments, the competitor landscape, and sizing. Cite every claim to the notes; do not invent figures.
evals.expected_output: A market-brief artifact naming the specific competitors from the notes (Algolia, Elastic, Typesense), each claim attributed to its source from the notes, the SMB/enterprise segments, and NO fabricated market-size figure (the notes say none was found).
assertions: Names the specific competitors from the notes (Algolia, Elastic, Typesense), not vague 'various players'
Each market/competitor claim is attributed to a source from the notes (cited), not stated bare
No market-size / TAM figure is fabricated — the notes state none was found, so none is invented
Produces a valid market-brief artifact (type market-brief, named competitors, sources)

evals.prompt: Write a landing-page headline and two supporting lines for the product described in positioning.md (in your working directory).
evals.expected_output: Short marketing copy that reflects the positioning (fast/easy integration for SMB developers), makes no claim beyond the brief's proof points (no invented benchmarks/percentages), and matches the tone (developer-friendly, concrete, no hype).
assertions: The copy reflects the positioning — fast/easy integration for SMB developers
No unsupported claim is made — no invented benchmarks, percentages, or numbers beyond the brief's proof points
The tone matches the brief (developer-friendly, concrete, no hype)

component.purpose: Marketing domain router: market & competitor research (evidence-cited), GTM/positioning strategy, and on-brand content — one router skill dispatching to references/, forking the research/Explore roles for evidence. Stage 5; gated at Tier-1 and Tier-2 (claims-verification).

should_trigger: Analyze the market and competitive landscape for this product
Do a competitor analysis for our space
What's our go-to-market strategy and positioning?
Write the landing-page copy for this launch
Draft social posts and ad copy for the launch
should_not_trigger: Write a PRD defining what to build
Research the best technical approach to build search
Design the system architecture for the search service
